NOVA Beast: Unleash 5,500W of Off-Road Power

Introducing the Eskute NOVA Beast Electric Dirt Bike – a high-performance machine built for riders who demand serious power, explosive acceleration, and confident control on challenging terrain. Combining a 5,500W peak hub motor, high-capacity 60V battery, hydraulic suspension, and hydraulic disc brakes, the NOVA Beast is engineered to deliver an exhilarating off-road riding experience.

At the heart of the NOVA Beast is a 5,500W peak motor delivering up to 250 N·m of torque, with a top speed of 35–50 MPH. Built for rapid launches, it accelerates from 0–10 MPH in just 0.9 seconds, while its powerful torque helps tackle steep and demanding terrain with confidence. With the ability to handle inclines of up to 45°, the NOVA Beast is ready for trails, hills, and rugged off-road adventures.

Powered by a 60V 27Ah battery, the NOVA Beast delivers up to 60 miles of range on a single charge under suitable riding conditions. The high-capacity battery provides consistent power for longer adventures, while the approximately 6–7 hour charging time gets you ready for your next ride.

Designed to absorb impacts across rough terrain, the NOVA Beast features 130mm of hydraulic front suspension travel paired with a hydraulic rear suspension system. Combined with 17-inch front and 14-inch rear 3.0-inch-wide all-terrain tires, this setup provides stability, traction, and control across dirt, gravel, uneven trails, and challenging terrain.

Powerful performance demands dependable stopping power. The NOVA Beast features 190mm hydraulic disc brakes for responsive and precise braking control. High-grip off-road footpegs help keep your feet securely positioned, while the rugged design gives riders the confidence to tackle demanding trails and technical terrain.

The full-color Smart Cockpit Display keeps essential riding information clearly visible, including speed, battery level, and riding mode, while Smart NFC Unlock provides convenient keyless access. Finished with a bright LED headlight for improved visibility, the Eskute NOVA Beast brings together power, range, suspension, braking, and smart technology in one purpose-built electric dirt bike. Ride harder. Go farther. Unleash the Beast.
